balls.text: on-pace full-toss outside off, 139.4ks. Mavi shuffles across off and aims to scoop it over short fine leg. However, he just deflects it back onto his own stumps
Mavi swings too early at a slower one outside off and misses. Nice little offcutter from Morris
full-toss on middle, dragged to deep midwicket
yorker on middle, squeezed straight to mid-off
Holes out to deep midwicket. Another slower ball short and outside off. Hip-high delivery, pulled flat and hard to Parag. Sharp catch in the outfield
pumped over wide long-off for six. On a length and wide of off, Cummins reaches out for the ball with his hands and unleashes a smooth swing through the line. Bam!
Mustafizur closes out the spell with another cutter, which runs past the outside edge. Samson gives up a bye. End of a fine spell from the Bangladesh seamer

slower cutter on leg stump, Cummins aims to loft down the ground, but ends up slicing it in the air. Three men, including Samson, converge around the ball which eventually drops into no-man's land at square leg
Mavi slices another slower ball to point and scampers across to the other end
cutter on the hips with fine leg inside the circle. Mavi gets it fine of short fine leg for four
back of a length and swerving away past the outside edge as a crease-bound Mavi wafts and misses outside off
full-toss, dips just a shade outside off, slapped down to long-off

overpitched and outside off, Karthik throws his bat at ball and drills it in the air. Sakariya at extra-cover leaps and plucks it out of thin air. Karthik goes for 25 off 24 balls. He couldn't get going either on this used track. End of a double-wicket over from Morris
slower dipper on off, 118.4ks, dug out for one. Top ball from Morris, plunged at Cummins

another on-pace slot ball, but Russell picks out long-on. Pitched up and angling into off and middle, Russell sits back, swishes, and holes out to Miller at the edge of the boundary. Morris wins the match-up. This is the fourth time he has got Russell in T20 cricket
slower ball floated well wide of off. Russell swings so very hard that he loses his shape. Off-side wide
wide yorker, Russell reaches outside off, but can't touch it. Samson thinks Russell is out caught behind, but the noise came from the bat jamming the ground
on-pace slot ball on off, Russell hangs so very deep in the crease and smashes a six over Morris' head
cutter into the pitch, back of a length and outside off, Russell swishes and does not make contact. These slower balls are holding up on this used track
slower ball, on a back of a length. Karthik pulls early and wears it on the hips. Good finish to over from Sakariya
slower ball, into the pitch, and angling away from Russell. He can only flap it into the leg side
low full-toss on middle, flicked in the air, lands in front of wide long-on. The outfielder runs in, stops, and opts to take it on the bounce
really full and outside off, not quite a yorker, but still a decent ball. Driven down to wide long-off
floats another slower ball past the tramline. Back-to-back off-side wides
Sakariya searches for a wide yorker, and pushes it past the tramline. Off-side wide
short ball on the hips, Karthik splices a pull in the air. The ball lands in front of deep midwicket
smeared straight of long-off. 114.3ks slower ball outside off, Karthik shimmies across and lets his hands flow through the line
pitched up and around off, Russell hangs back and punches past him to long-off. Oops, the no-ball siren goes off
Slower short ball wide of off. This sits up to be hit. Karthik duly dispatches it between deep midwicket and long leg for four. Powerful pull. KKR need more such boundaries
full-toss outside off, Karthik stretches out and drives straight to extra-cover
starts on middle and leg and floats away outside off as Karthik stabs early at this whippy cutter and is beaten on the outside edge
another cutter, shorter and running away outside off, Karthik opens the bat-face and guides it to backward point
115.3ks, slower offcutter. Tripathi looks to take it on with a slog-sweep. But he only gets more height as opposed to distance. Dragged from a middle-stump line to Parag at deep midwicket
very full and wide of off, offcutter, carved to sweeper cover
back of a length and angling into the hips with fine leg inside the circle. Sakariya gets away with it as Karthik can just tickle it to that infielder
Sakariya aims for the yorker, comes out as a full-toss, which is clattered away from a middle-stump line to the backward square leg fence
slower short ball at the body, 111ks, Tripathi heaves it away to deep midwicket
wide yorker, dug out to long-off. Excellent bowling from Sakariya
Tripathi plants his front leg and slices this length ball over Sakariya's head. Long-on runs around and gathers the ball
back of a length and outside off, seems like a cutter, Karthik slaps it away between backward point and short third man
quickish slider on middle, Karthik goes on the back foot and hammers it to deep midwicket
slower legbreak from Tewatia, 78ks, full and wide like Chahal often does. Beats the batsman and Samson too. Tripathi gets across to the other end
low full-toss outside off, whipped strongly to long-on
Karthik now aims for the reverse-sweep, Tewatia slides it flatter and shorter to hit the thigh pad
swept flat and hard to the square boundary. Karthik stretches out to this legbreak outside off and hauls it away between long leg and deep midwicket
shovelled down to long-on for one
slower ball, into the pitch, Karthik searches for a cut, but only chops it behind to the keeper. Samson burgles a quiet over from Dube
punched into the covers for an urgent single. Buttler swoops down on the ball from extra-cover, but can't throw the stumps down
down the track and hauled through midwicket off the inner half. Slower variation from Dube
full and angling into middle, punched down to long-on
jumps from a back of a length outside off and defeats Karthik's back-foot cut
down the track and cracked down to long-off
Tewatia tests Karthik with a wrong'un. He's suspect to this incoming variation. He plays back and defends it back to the bowler
back of a length and sliding in at the stumps, forced off the back foot to long-on
on a length and sliding into middle, tickled into the leg side for one
dangled up and breaking into middle, another googly, played back to the bowler
googly on a back of a length, forced down to long-on off the back foot
Tripathi lunges forward, lines up this full legbreak from Tewatia and lifts it over extra-cover. Collapses his back knee and goes inside-out
back of a length and outside off, dinks to point, takes on Jaiswal's arm, I think, for a risky single
bouncer outside off, Tripathi shelves the hook. One for the over
dug in short and outside off, slashed to point once again
short and outside off, slashed off the back foot to backward point

pitched up on the stumps, driven ram-rod straight so much it hits the stumps at the non-striker's end. The ball gets deflected to Morris. Tripathi takes a few paces down the pitch, stops. Morgan responds and that results in a mix-up. Morgan then has to undo his steps, but before that Morris flicks it onto his stumps. Morgan has a wry smile on his face as he walks back for a duck without facing a ball. Replays indicate that the ball was deflected off Morgan's bat that was in the way. What an unfortunate way to go. That, by the way, is the first dot ball faced by Tripathi
More intent from Tripathi. Short and outside off. Tripathi had jumped across off even before the bowler delivered. He shovels it over Mustafizur at short fine leg
short of a length and slanting into middle and leg, punched away to wide long-on off the back foot

After dropping one earlier in the evening, Jaiswal finds redemption. In-to-the-pitch offcutter, gets big on Narine. He top-edges a hook high in the air. Jaiswal tears in from long leg, dives forward and takes it with both hands, inches from the ground. Terrific work from Jaiswal
chopped between backward point and short third man
quicker middle-stump yorker, Narine squirts it down to long-off
slower yorker, dips into middle, Narine brings his bat down and jams it to extra-cover
picked off the hips wide of short fine leg
middle-stump yorker, great execution from Sakariya, dug out back to him
bumper outside off, Narine sways out of the way. One for the over, says the square-leg umpire
Tripathi latches onto width outside off with a high-elbowed drive to sweeper cover
slower ball around off, slashed out to sweeper cover
really full on middle, in the swinging arc of Narine. He clears his front leg, gets underneath the length and clouts it over extra-cover

Sakariya finds some extra bounce and has Rana slashing behind. Kicks up slightly from a back of a length and outside off, Rana creates some swinging room, chucks his hands at the ball and edges it behind. KKR's openers have piled the pressure on the middle order
low full toss on middle, whips it to long-on

rocks back and whips a very quick legbreak between long-on and midwicket. Parag does well to stop the boundary, but such is Tripathi's power that the relay to Morris doesn't quite work out right and they still get three
googly, to which Rana turns the face of the bat too early, and gets a leading edge down to long-off
shimmies down the track and whacks a legbreak drifting into him, cramping him up, to long-on
lunges forward to take the legbreak outside leg stump on the full and sweeps to the right of short fine leg
leans forward to the pitch of the legbreak and drives to the left of long-off
pumped over midwicket! 106ks offcutter outside off, hip-high delivery. Rana delays the pull and muscles it over the leg side
spliced in the air, but lands in front of point. Ofcutter with extra bounce
slower ball, finishes on the hips, tickled to long leg
Attacking intent from Tripathi first ball. He ventures down the track and smacks a length ball on middle over Unadkat's head
slower ball, on a length and comes in on middle, clipped through the vacant spaces at midwicket
pitched up and outside off, driven through the line, but the man at short cover throws himself to his left to intercept the ball
another offcutter, dips at Rana, slugs it behind square off the inner half. KKR dawdle to 25 for 1 in the powerplay
short and climbs outside off, Rana swishes and misses

Gill has been run-out for an utterly sluggish 11 off 19 balls. Slower cutter, on a yorker length, just a shade outside off. Gill jabs it away just wide of short cover and sets off. But Buttler swoops down on the ball and effects an under-arm direct hit. There wasn't a single there. Perhaps, Gill was just desperate to get out of strike
short-arm jabbed away from off...but straight to midwicket. Gill can't find the gap or the boundary. This powerplay could hurt KKR
slower cutter outside off, hauled away through square leg off the inner half. Rana doesn't read the offcutter
nice and full, nipping into the pads from left-arm over as Rana falls over the flick. The sharp angle and movement means it would have slipped down leg. RR decide against a review
banged in short and fizzing into the body, rushes Gill into a hook. He can only glove it to short fine leg. Gill's powerplay struggles continue
low full-toss, slanting into middle, picked off to the right of deep midwicket for a double
Gill charges down the track, has a roundhouse swipe to the leg side, and misses. Morris did well to bang a cutter into the pitch and defeat the advancing batter
back of a length and skidding back in at 136ks to cramp Gill on the pull and thump his thigh pad
full and on middle and leg, slower ball, Gill drives straight to short midwicket
Gill steps out to his first ball, Morris drags it shorter on middle, stabbed straight to extra-cover
shorter on the hips, tucked away through the leg side

Dropped by Jaiswal. Another offcutter from Mustafizur, he asks Gill to manufacture pace of his own. Gill backs away and slices in the air off the outer half. Jaiswal runs in from sweeper cover, dives forward, but the ball pops out of his hands. That should've been taken
whippy cutter from Mustafizur, Gill is early into the flick, checks his shot and then tickles it gently to short fine leg
shovelled with the bottom wrist over midwicket. Veering into the pads, picked up and put away as Gill gets going
length ball on middle and leg, Gill flicks unambitiously to short midwicket. Another sluggish start for him in the powerplay
he starts off with a short ball too, on middle, forced to midwicket off the back foot
slower ball, floated on the pads, clipped away to deep square leg. Another offcutter from Unadkat
Unadkat hits a hard length and brings this back into Rana, chopped square through the off side off the back foot
down the track, Rana meets a full ball outside off early, drives to mid-off, and yells "Noooo!'
Rana rides the bounce of this shorter one outside off and taps it to the right of backward point

on a length and attacking the stumps, this is a middle-stump delivery from Unadkat. Rana shuffles away outside leg, creates swinging room and late-cuts it between backward point and short third man. Well done, Rana
much fuller from Unadkat, gets it to swing away from the left-hander, snags the outside edge before it rolls to short third man
fractionally short and wide of off, Rana keeps sweeper cover busy with another back-foot cut
bumper, sails through to Samson. Wide called for height
short and kicks up further from outside off, chopped away square through the off side, but can't get it away from point
jabbed away against the angle to mid-on for an urgent single
shortish and outside off, both these left-arm seamers have been short with their lengths. Blocked off the back foot
back of a length and outside off, punched through the line to sweeper cover
on a length and largely holds its line outside off, Rana sits back and guides it to extra-cover
some movement for Sakariya but he pushes it down the leg side. Wide
slower-ball offcutter, Unadat cuts his pace to 112ks, Gill checks his drive and dinks the ball to cover
back of a length and angling across just a shade outside off, Gill camps back and plays it back to Unadkat
keeps it short and wide of off, chopped off the back foot to the off-side sweeper
shorter, wider, flayed away over the cover-point region as Rana reaches out for the ball. Rana comes back for the second
similar length and wobbles away in the channel, Rana drags his bat inside the line and lets it pass
back of a length and shapes away against the angle, some extra bounce to boot. Patted to point with an open face off the back foot
whipped away from outside off to deep midwicket. Samson guides RR to victory
another slower cutter on middle, dabbed between point and cover with an open bat-face
slower ball on middle, into the pitch, defended off the back foot to short midwicket
on the pads, turned between deep square leg and long leg for a double
short and slanting into a leg-side flick to deep square leg
fullish and outside off, clipped to deep midwicket off the front foot
whipped off the pads to long leg's right
Miller jumps on top of a short ball outside off and cracks it hard to the right of point
overpitched on the pads, some seriously whippage from Miller. Put away between midwicket and mid-on
short at the body, fended awkwardly to long leg
good length on middle and leg, Miller shuffles across and works to short midwicket
slower ball from Cummins, nicked onto the pads. The ball then rolls wide of Karthik behind the stumps
full on off, forward and driven down to mid-off
slower ball, offcutter on a back of a length, glanced behind square off the back foot
very full on the pads, picked off to the right of Rana at long leg
on a length and angling across off stump, Miller deliberately opens the bat-face and steers it fine of deep third man for four
full and slanting into off, whisked away to the right of mid-on
whipped past the left of midwicket and right of the leg-side sweeper
back of a length and angling across off, guided to point
Krishna rushes Miller into a pull. Under-edged onto the pad

full on the stumps, struck hard to midwicket. Morgan throws himself to his right, stops the ball, and relays it to Narine at mid-on. He has a shy at the stumps and misses. A direct hit could've got Samson
first boundary since the 11th over for RR. Shorter and angling away outside off, leans back and cuts it to the left of deep third man. Rana slides in vain and gives up four
another leg-side wide from Krishna
full-toss fired down the leg side at 143ks, leg-side wide
short and wide of off, cutter, Samson delays the cut and steers it to deep third man
fuller and angling away outside off, lashed away to short extra-cover

Mavi pings the front pad once again, but this seems to have pitched outside leg once again. Not given out lbw by umpire Singh. KKR now review it. No bat involved once again. Ultra Edge confirms it. Yes, this pitched outside leg too
short and nipping back in to cramp the batsman for both room and length. Inside-edged onto the pad
short and outside off, Samson rides it down to deep third man
floats a slower ball down the leg side. Wide
on a length and angling across off, Miller pushes to mid-off and hares across for one

Miller has been given out lbw, but he reviews immediately. This seems to have pitched outside leg before skidding in to strike the front pad. Daylight between bat and ball, but it had pitched well outside leg. Umpire Navdeep Singh has to overturn his on-field out decision
on a length and outside off, Samson moves forward and runs it away to the left of point
banged in short at the body, fended to deep fine leg
Krishna bounces out Tewatia. Another chest-high short delivery cramps him on the pull. He can only top-edge it to Nagarkoti at long leg
short and angling in, ramped to third man
chest-high short ball, pulled away to deep midwicket
short ball, skidding into the body of Samson, who does not get hold of the pull. They pinch a leg bye as Tewatia shows some urgency
shorter and outside off, jabbed to sweeper cover. End of another fine spell from Varun

Varun almost strikes. Gill almost takes this chance at the midwicket boundary. He catches the ball, but the momentum pushes him beyond the boundary. Before he falls back, he tosses it into play, but the can't get back quickly enough to take it on the rebound which was wider as well. Googly from Varun, slogged away in the air. Replays indicate Gill didn't go beyond the boundary. He seems to have misjudged this chance
swept away to the left of the leg-side sweeper for a double
full and sliding away outside off, may have been the googly, prodded to the covers
legbreak outside off, chopped fine of Rana at deep third man
darted on middle, played back to Varun
shortish offbreak, at off stump, Samson punches down to long-on
slider, takes the outside edge and rolls away past Russell at slip
lobbed up just a shade outside off, eased off the front foot to long-off
on the pads, diverted to fine leg
on a length and spinning down the leg side, diverted away fine of long leg
speared outside off, forward and patted to short cover
pushed through on off stump, played back to Varun

Varun provides KKR with the breakthrough! Carved into the lap of short third man. Googly from Varun, he takes it away from the left-hander's swinging arc. Dube still dares to hoick it over midwicket. Instead, he slices it to Krishna
Varun gets another one to slide past Dube's outside edge
102ks offbreak from outside off, Dube throws his bat at ball and edges it just past the left of DK. Nobody at slip to gobble that up
speared into middle, pushed back down the pitch
legbreak outside off, played into the covers with soft hands
turned off the pads to short midwicket
knuckle ball, drifts away outside off, Samson leans back and punches it to the left of short cover
darted on the hips, Dube swivels into a pull and hits the ball to deep square leg
fired into the pads at 95ks, but this is heading down the leg side
back of a length and angling into off, punched down to long-on
good length and spins in at middle, nurdled to midwicket. Samson sends Dube back. There was no single there
back of a length and just a shade outside off, tip and run to point
slower offcutter outside off, left alone but it's too wide
good length and angling into middle and leg, tucked away to long leg
banged in short and angling away outside off, helped away to deep third man
offcutter outside off, dinked down to deep third man
nonchalantly pulled over midwicket. Shortish and around off, hip-high delivery. Samson opens up his hips and swats it away over the leg side
pitched up and slanting away outside off, Dube aims to hit over the top, ends up slicing the ball over extra-cover
shorter and this knuckle ball moves away from Samson. Stabbed to short cover
on a length and spins back in quickly, defended back to Narine
full and spins away from Dube, he carves it over extra-cover, but sweeper has it covered in the deep
punched off the back foot to the right of sweeper cover
knuckle ball on a length and breaks away outside off, played back to the bowler
very full on leg stump, Dube can't get underneath the length, hauled away to midwicket
knuckle ball, short and wide of off, slapped away to the left of sweeper cover. The no-ball siren goes off

shorter and spins away outside off, Dube jumps back and scythes it more or less straight to Nagarkoti at long-off. He runs in and lazily lets the ball burst through to the boundary. He should've looked to collect the ball with both hands
looks like another short legbreak, which is punched off the back foot to long-on
punched down the ground to wide long-off
another legbreak, shorter and just a shade outside off. Samson goes back and flicks through midwicket
Varun brings this legbreak back into Dube, inside-edged behind square on the leg side
tossed outside off, driven through the line to long-off
big-turning offbreak from Narine. Zips past the outside edge as Dube jabs and misses in the channel
quicker and on middle, defended back
Dube is a spin-hitter and he fulfills his role by muscling Narine over midwicket. He plants his front leg and launches this full ball over midwicket
slider on a length on middle, bunted down to long-on
Narine hides the ball behind his back and then spears it on middle and leg, Dube camps back and works it to the midwicket region
flat and quick on middle, punched down the ground to long-on
Mavi slams it on a hard length, on middle, Dube blocks off the back foot
back of a length, starts outside off, and seams away further to end up as an off-side wide
Holes out to the sub fielder at sweep cover. Much fuller and angling across the left-hander. Jaiswal chucks his hands at the ball and slices it in the air to Nagarkoti
short and slanting away outside off, Jaiswal sizes it up, clears his front leg, and crunnnnnnnches it over extra-cover
on the hips, tucked through square leg
on a length and veers in from outside off, no shot
banged in short and shoved down the leg side for a wide

back of a length and angling in, a bit too straight in line, Samson brings his wrists into play and picks it away to the left of short fine leg. Replays indicate he actually picked it from an off-stump line
Varun overpitches another one outside off and offers width, Jaiswal leans into it and caresses it through the covers
good length and angling into off from round the wicket, played back to Varun
back of a length and spinning into middle, Samson goes back and works through square leg
overpitched and outside off, 95ks, Samson leans into it and drills a drive to the left of extra-cover

Varun comes back to pin Buttler lbw. Quick fizzer from Varun again, fuller than the last ball, shaping into middle and rushes in to hit Buttler on his front pad in line with middle as he plays around it. It looks plumb. Buttler has a word with Jaiswal and then walks off, deciding against a review
slider outside off, flat and on a back of a length, Buttler lines it up and laces it between extra-cover and mid-off
short of length outside off, goes for the cut but is beaten
fuller outside off, leans into it but extra cover comes in the way
pitched up outside off, drives it on the front foot but cannot beat the cover fielder
fuller, just outside off, Jaiswal puts it away, his second boundary through the midwicket region
length ball outside off, not much room this time. Jaiswal looks to push it from the back foot and gets beaten
fuller and angling in. Buttler looks to push it on the leg side but misses. Hit on the pads but was going down the leg side. Gets a leg bye
length ball outside off, stays back and taps it towards short midwicket for a quick single

that hit Buttler right on the grille as he went for the pull and turned his head away. He is a bit shaken. Is in pain. Cummins checks on him straightaway. The physio is out on the field. Buttler is being checked for a concussion. Buttler seems okay and is ready to resume after a helmet replacement
short of length at the batter, pulls it in front of square leg. There is a fielder in the deep
back-to-back fours for Jaiswal. Cummins goes short of length but enough room for the batter to free his arms. Cuts it to the left of a diving Gill at backward point
fuller on the pads and flicked away through midwicket. A long chase for Rahul Tripathi from deep square leg; the ball beats him quite comfortably. That shot would give Jaiswal some confidence
length outside off, Jaiswal uses the cut shot once again but finds the point fielder
Mavi gets away with this one. A length ball straying down the leg side. Buttler was outside the line and expected it to be called a wide. No, not today

dropped by Gill at backward point. Jaiswal backed away and went for the cut. Finally some willow on the leather. He really smashed it and Gill wasn't expecting it to come to him at such a speed. Bursts through his hands
length ball outside off, leaving the batter. Jaiswal pushes at it and gets beaten. Yet to put bat on ball
closer to the batter this time. Pitching on a length and leaving the batter. Movement off the seam. Beats Jaiswal, almost squaring him up
length ball, angled across the left-hander. Left alone watchfully

length ball angling in. Buttler was caught on the crease as he looked to defend it. But the angle meant he failed to get any bat on it. Gets a leg bye as the ball hits the back thigh and rolls towards covers
